/benzinga/v1/earnings.estimated_revenue: The analyst consensus estimate for the company's revenue in the given period.

/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.channel: Transaction channel. Possible values: online, offline, bnpl (buy now pay later platforms such as Scala, Klarna, Zilch).
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.consumer_type: The panel the account is sourced from. Possible values: consumer_credit, consumer_debit, open_banking.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.eight_day_rolling_category_accounts: The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country, consumer type, and that transacted in this merchant category (MCC Group) over the prior 8 days. Used for short-term normalization calculations (e.g., spend per 1000 panelists = (total_spend / eight_day_rolling_category_accounts) * 1000).
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.eight_day_rolling_total_accounts: The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country and consumer type that had any transaction activity (across all categories) over the prior 8 days. Provides a baseline for total panel size.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.mcc_group: Merchant category code group associated with the merchant or payment processor.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.merchant_industry: Industry name based on GICS/BICS/ICB data classification for the merchant.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.merchant_ticker: Stock ticker associated with the merchant (~250 US public companies mapped). Uses Bloomberg tickers and they are point in time.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.name: The merchant or entity name for this aggregate (lowercase). When type is 'merchant', this value can be used as the lookup_name in the merchant-hierarchy endpoint to retrieve full corporate hierarchy details.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.parent_name: Merchant's parent business name (Title Case). Useful for aggregating transactions across subsidiary brands. Also available in the merchant-hierarchy endpoint for full corporate structure.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.published_date: The date when this data version was published. For original data, this is approximately 7 days after transaction_date.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.spend_in_distinct_account_key_count: The count of distinct account keys (unique consumer accounts) with inbound transactions.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.spend_in_spend: The total inbound transaction amount (refunds, returns, credits) in the specified currency for this aggregation. Values are positive, representing money flowing back into consumer accounts.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.spend_in_transaction_count: The count of inbound transactions (refunds, returns).
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.spend_out_distinct_account_key_count: The count of distinct account keys (unique consumer accounts) with outbound transactions.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.spend_out_spend: The total outbound transaction amount (money spent by consumers) in the specified currency for this aggregation. Values are negative, representing money flowing out of consumer accounts.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.spend_out_transaction_count: The count of outbound transactions (purchases, payments).
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.total_accounts: The total count of distinct consumer accounts with any transaction activity for this aggregation.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.total_spend: Sum of spend_out_spend and spend_in_spend. Typically negative (net outflow). A positive value indicates refunds exceeded new spending for this aggregation.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.total_transactions: The total count of all transactions (outbound + inbound).
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.transaction_currency: ISO currency code for the transaction (base card/account currency). Always EUR or GBP in this dataset. All spend amounts are denominated in this currency.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.transaction_date: The calendar date when the consumer transactions occurred.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.twenty_eight_day_rolling_category_accoun: The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country, consumer type, and that transacted in this merchant category (MCC Group) over the prior 28 days. Used for longer-term normalization calculations.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.twenty_eight_day_rolling_total_accounts: The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country and consumer type that had any transaction activity (across all categories) over the prior 28 days. Provides a longer-term baseline for total panel size.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.type: The type of aggregation. Can be 'merchant' or 'payment_processor'.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-aggreg.user_country: Country of consumer's residence (ISO codes). Available countries: UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, AT. Values outside these are mapped to 'unknown'.

/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.active_from: Date this merchant hierarchy mapping became applicable. A value of 0001-01-01 indicates no known start date. Use with active_to to match against transaction_date from the merchant-aggregates endpoint to perform point-in-time queries.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.active_to: Date after which this merchant hierarchy mapping is no longer applicable due to a corporate action. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates the mapping is currently active.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.category: Merchant category assigned by the data provider (Title Case, e.g., 'Groceries', 'General Merchandise', 'Travel'). Values are managed by the data provider and may expand over time.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.grandparent_ticker: Stock ticker of the merchant's grandparent company. Uses Bloomberg standard.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.great_grandparent_name: Merchant's great-grandparent business name (Title Case, top-level corporate entity).
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.great_grandparent_ticker: Stock ticker of the merchant's great-grandparent company (top-level corporate entity). Uses Bloomberg standard.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.industry: Industry classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.industry_group: Industry group classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.listing_status: Whether the merchant is a publicly listed company or private. Possible values: public, private.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.lookup_name: Lowercase merchant tag used for joining with the merchant-aggregates endpoint name field (e.g., 'asda', 'amazon').
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.normalized_name: Cleaned, standardized merchant display name (Title Case, e.g., 'Asda', 'Amazon').
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.parent_name: Merchant's parent business name (Title Case). Useful for aggregating transactions across subsidiary brands.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.parent_ticker: Stock ticker of the merchant's parent company. Uses Bloomberg standard.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.sector: Sector classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.sub_industry: Sub-industry classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards.
/consumer-spending/eu/v1/merchant-hierar.ticker: Stock ticker associated with the merchant (~250 US public companies mapped). Uses Bloomberg standard.

/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.open: The opening price within the timeframe.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.high: The highest price within the timeframe.

/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.close: The last price within the timeframe.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.volume: The number of contracts that traded within the timeframe.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.session_end_date: Also known as the trading date, the date of the end of the trading session, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Sessions are named by this end date, while window_start holds the session's start date, which for session candles is the day before.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.window_start: The timestamp of the beginning of the candlestick’s aggregation window.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.dollar_volume: The sum of price × size across all trades in the window, expressed in the contract's quoted price units, which are the same units as the bar's open, high, low, and close. Despite the field name, no contract multiplier is applied, so this is not a notional dollar value. See the Products endpoint (https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/products) for contract multiplier details. Because dollar_volume is a raw sum, you can use it to compute a volume-weighted average price (VWAP) over any span of bars: sum dollar_volume across the bars in the window and divide by the summed volume.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.transactions: The number of transactions that occurred within the timeframe.
/futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}.settlement_price: The price the contract settled at for this session. Included for session, week, month, quarter, and year candles; for multi-session candles it is the settlement of the final session in the period. Not returned for intraday candles (sec, min, hour).

/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.debt_current: Short-term borrowings and the current portion of long-term debt due within one year.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.deferred_revenue_current: Customer payments received in advance for goods or services to be delivered within one year.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.filing_date: The date of the most recent SEC filing that included this period's data. This is not necessarily the date this period was originally filed. Because SEC filings restate comparative data for prior periods, multiple records can share the same filing_date. For example, an annual 10-K reports three years of results, and a 10-Q includes prior period comparatives. To find the original filing date for a specific 10-K or 10-Q, use the SEC EDGAR filings index endpoint (/stocks/filings/vX/index).
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.fiscal_quarter: The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.fiscal_year: The fiscal year for the reporting period.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.goodwill: Intangible asset representing the excess of purchase price over fair value of net assets acquired in business combinations.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.intangible_assets_net: Intangible assets other than goodwill, including patents, trademarks, and customer relationships, net of accumulated amortization.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.inventories: Raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods held for sale in the ordinary course of business.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.long_term_debt_and_capital_lease_obligat: Long-term borrowings and capital lease obligations with maturities greater than one year.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.noncontrolling_interest: Equity in consolidated subsidiaries not owned by the parent company, representing minority shareholders' ownership.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.other_assets: Non-current assets not classified elsewhere, including long-term investments, deferred tax assets, and other long-term assets.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.other_current_assets: Current assets not classified elsewhere, including prepaid expenses, taxes receivable, and other assets expected to be converted to cash within one year.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.other_equity: Equity components not classified elsewhere in shareholders' equity.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.other_noncurrent_liabilities: Non-current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including deferred tax liabilities, pension obligations, and other long-term liabilities.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.period_end: The last date of the reporting period, representing the specific point in time when the balance sheet snapshot was taken.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.preferred_stock: Par or stated value of preferred shares outstanding with preferential rights over common stock.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.property_plant_equipment_net: Tangible fixed assets used in operations, reported net of accumulated depreciation.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.receivables: Amounts owed to the company by customers and other parties, primarily accounts receivable, net of allowances for doubtful accounts.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.retained_earnings_deficit: Cumulative net income earned by the company less dividends paid to shareholders since inception.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.short_term_investments: Marketable securities and other investments with maturities of one year or less that are not classified as cash equivalents.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.tickers: A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.timeframe: The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_assets: Sum of all current and non-current assets representing everything the company owns or controls.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_current_assets: Sum of all current assets expected to be converted to cash, sold, or consumed within one year.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_current_liabilities: Sum of all liabilities expected to be settled within one year.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_equity: Sum of all equity components representing shareholders' total ownership interest in the company.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_equity_attributable_to_parent: Total shareholders' equity attributable to the parent company, excluding noncontrolling interests.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_liabilities: Sum of all current and non-current liabilities representing everything the company owes.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.total_liabilities_and_equity: Sum of total liabilities and total equity, which should equal total assets per the fundamental accounting equation.
/stocks/financials/v1/balance-sheets.treasury_stock: Cost of the company's own shares that have been repurchased and are held in treasury, typically reported as a negative value.

/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.cash_from_operating_activities_continuin: Cash generated from continuing business operations before discontinued operations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.change_in_cash_and_equivalents: Net change in cash and cash equivalents during the period, representing the sum of operating, investing, and financing cash flows plus currency effects.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.change_in_other_operating_assets_and_lia: Net change in working capital components including accounts receivable, inventory, accounts payable, and other operating items.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.cik: The company's Central Index Key (CIK), a unique identifier assigned by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). You can look up a company’s CIK using the SEC CIK Lookup tool (https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/cik-lookup).
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.depreciation_depletion_and_amortization: Non-cash charges for the reduction in value of tangible and intangible assets over time.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.dividends: Cash payments to shareholders in the form of dividends, typically reported as negative values.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.effect_of_currency_exchange_rate: Impact of foreign exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents denominated in foreign currencies.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.filing_date: The date of the most recent SEC filing that included this period's data. This is not necessarily the date this period was originally filed. Because SEC filings restate comparative data for prior periods, multiple records can share the same filing_date. For example, an annual 10-K reports three years of results, and a 10-Q includes prior period comparatives. To find the original filing date for a specific 10-K or 10-Q, use the SEC EDGAR filings index endpoint (/stocks/filings/vX/index).
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.fiscal_quarter: The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.fiscal_year: The fiscal year for the reporting period.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.income_loss_from_discontinued_operations: After-tax income or loss from business operations that have been discontinued.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.long_term_debt_issuances_repayments: Net cash flows from issuing or repaying long-term debt obligations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_financing_activities: Total cash generated or used by financing activities, including debt issuance, debt repayment, dividends, and share transactions.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_financing_activities_conti: Cash flows from financing activities of continuing operations before discontinued operations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_financing_activities_disco: Cash flows from financing activities of discontinued business segments.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_investing_activities: Total cash generated or used by investing activities, including capital expenditures, acquisitions, and asset sales.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_investing_activities_conti: Cash flows from investing activities of continuing operations before discontinued operations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_investing_activities_disco: Cash flows from investing activities of discontinued business segments.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_operating_activities: Total cash generated or used by operating activities, representing cash flow from core business operations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_cash_from_operating_activities_disco: Cash flows from operating activities of discontinued business segments.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.net_income: Net income used as the starting point for operating cash flow calculations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.noncontrolling_interests: Cash flows related to minority shareholders in consolidated subsidiaries.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.other_cash_adjustments: Other miscellaneous adjustments to cash flows not classified elsewhere.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.other_financing_activities: Cash flows from financing activities not classified elsewhere, including share repurchases and other equity transactions.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.other_investing_activities: Cash flows from investing activities not classified elsewhere, including acquisitions, divestitures, and investments.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.other_operating_activities: Other adjustments to reconcile net income to operating cash flow not classified elsewhere.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.period_end: The last date of the reporting period (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.purchase_of_property_plant_and_equipment: Cash outflows for capital expenditures on fixed assets, typically reported as negative values.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.sale_of_property_plant_and_equipment: Cash inflows from disposing of fixed assets, typically reported as positive values.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.short_term_debt_issuances_repayments: Net cash flows from issuing or repaying short-term debt obligations.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.tickers: A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company.
/stocks/financials/v1/cash-flow-statemen.timeframe: The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual, trailing_twelve_months.

/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.basic_earnings_per_share: Earnings per share calculated using the weighted average number of basic shares outstanding. For TTM records, recalculated as TTM net income divided by average basic shares outstanding over the four quarters.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.basic_shares_outstanding: Weighted average number of common shares outstanding during the period, used in basic EPS calculation. For TTM records, represents the average over the four most recent quarters.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.cik: The company's Central Index Key (CIK), a unique identifier assigned by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). You can look up a company’s CIK using the SEC CIK Lookup tool (https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/cik-lookup).
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.consolidated_net_income_loss: Total net income or loss for the consolidated entity including all subsidiaries.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.cost_of_revenue: Direct costs attributable to the production of goods or services sold, also known as cost of goods sold (COGS).
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.depreciation_depletion_amortization: Non-cash expenses representing the allocation of asset costs over their useful lives.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.diluted_earnings_per_share: Earnings per share calculated using diluted shares outstanding, including the effect of potentially dilutive securities. For TTM records, recalculated as TTM net income divided by average diluted shares outstanding over the four quarters.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.diluted_shares_outstanding: Weighted average number of shares outstanding including the dilutive effect of stock options, warrants, and convertible securities. For TTM records, represents the average over the four most recent quarters.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.discontinued_operations: After-tax results from business segments that have been or will be disposed of.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.ebitda: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, a measure of operating performance.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.equity_in_affiliates: The company's share of income or losses from equity method investments in affiliated companies.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.extraordinary_items: Unusual and infrequent gains or losses that are both unusual in nature and infrequent in occurrence.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.filing_date: The date of the most recent SEC filing that included this period's data. This is not necessarily the date this period was originally filed. Because SEC filings restate comparative data for prior periods, multiple records can share the same filing_date. For example, an annual 10-K reports three years of results, and a 10-Q includes prior period comparatives. To find the original filing date for a specific 10-K or 10-Q, use the SEC EDGAR filings index endpoint (/stocks/filings/vX/index).
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.fiscal_quarter: The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.fiscal_year: The fiscal year for the reporting period.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.gross_profit: Revenue minus cost of revenue, representing profit before operating expenses.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.income_before_income_taxes: Pre-tax income calculated as operating income plus total other income/expense.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.income_taxes: Income tax expense or benefit for the period.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.interest_expense: Cost of borrowed funds, including interest on debt and other financing obligations.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.interest_income: Income earned from interest-bearing investments and cash equivalents.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.net_income_loss_attributable_common_shar: Net income or loss available to common shareholders after preferred dividends and noncontrolling interests.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.noncontrolling_interest: The portion of net income attributable to minority shareholders in consolidated subsidiaries.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.operating_income: Income from operations calculated as gross profit minus total operating expenses, excluding non-operating items.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.other_income_expense: Non-operating income and expenses not related to the company's core business operations.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.other_operating_expenses: Operating expenses not classified in the main expense categories.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.period_end: The last date of the reporting period (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.preferred_stock_dividends_declared: Dividends declared on preferred stock during the period.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.research_development: Expenses incurred for research and development activities to create new products or improve existing ones.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.revenue: Total revenue or net sales for the period, representing the company's gross income from operations.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.selling_general_administrative: Expenses related to selling products and general administrative costs not directly tied to production.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.tickers: A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.timeframe: The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual, trailing_twelve_months.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.total_operating_expenses: Sum of all operating expenses including cost of revenue, SG&A, R&D, depreciation, and other operating expenses.
/stocks/financials/v1/income-statements.total_other_income_expense: Net total of all non-operating income and expenses including interest income, interest expense, and other items.

/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.price: Stock price used in ratio calculations, typically the closing price for the given date.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.average_volume: Average trading volume over the last 30 trading days, providing context for liquidity.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.cash: Cash ratio, calculated as cash and cash equivalents divided by current liabilities, measuring the most liquid form of liquidity coverage.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.cik: Central Index Key (CIK) number assigned by the SEC to identify the company.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.date: Date for which the ratios are calculated, representing the trading date with available price data.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.current: Current ratio, calculated as total current assets divided by total current liabilities, measuring short-term liquidity.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.debt_to_equity: Debt-to-equity ratio, calculated as total debt (current debt plus long-term debt) divided by total shareholders' equity, measuring financial leverage.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.dividend_yield: Dividend yield, calculated as annual dividends per share divided by stock price, measuring the income return on investment.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.earnings_per_share: Earnings per share, calculated as trailing twelve months (TTM) net income available to common shareholders divided by point-in-time shares outstanding as of the price date, assuming all shares of other share classes are converted to this share class. This is not weighted average basic or diluted shares outstanding, so this value will not match the reported basic or diluted EPS on the income statements endpoint.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.enterprise_value: Enterprise value, calculated as market capitalization plus total debt minus cash and cash equivalents, representing total company value.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.ev_to_ebitda: Enterprise value to EBITDA ratio, calculated as enterprise value divided by EBITDA, measuring company valuation relative to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.ev_to_sales: Enterprise value to sales ratio, calculated as enterprise value divided by revenue, measuring company valuation relative to sales.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.free_cash_flow: Free cash flow, calculated as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures (purchase of property, plant, and equipment).
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.market_cap: Market capitalization, calculated as stock price multiplied by total shares outstanding.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.price_to_book: Price-to-book ratio, calculated as stock price divided by book value per share, comparing market value to book value.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.price_to_cash_flow: Price-to-cash-flow ratio, calculated as stock price divided by operating cash flow per share. Only calculated when operating cash flow per share is positive.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.price_to_earnings: Price-to-earnings ratio, calculated as stock price divided by earnings per share. Only calculated when earnings per share is positive.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.price_to_free_cash_flow: Price-to-free-cash-flow ratio, calculated as stock price divided by free cash flow per share. Only calculated when free cash flow per share is positive.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.price_to_sales: Price-to-sales ratio, calculated as stock price divided by revenue per share, measuring valuation relative to sales.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.quick: Quick ratio (acid-test ratio), calculated as (current assets minus inventories) divided by current liabilities, measuring immediate liquidity.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.return_on_assets: Return on assets ratio, calculated as net income divided by total assets, measuring how efficiently a company uses its assets to generate profit.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.return_on_equity: Return on equity ratio, calculated as net income divided by total shareholders' equity, measuring profitability relative to shareholders' equity.
/stocks/financials/v1/ratios.ticker: Stock ticker symbol for the company.

/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.issuer_cik: SEC Central Index Key of the issuer company (10 digits, zero-padded).
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.issuer_name: Name of the issuer company as reported in the filings.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.last_filing_date: Filing date of the latest filing that reported one of these transactions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Transactions are usually filed within two business days.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.net_value: Value purchased minus value sold in USD.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.planned_purchase_value: Value of shares purchased under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in USD. Zero on filings before the plan checkbox was introduced in 2023.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.planned_sale_value: Value of shares sold under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in USD. Zero on filings before the plan checkbox was introduced in 2023.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.purchase_value: Value of shares purchased in USD.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.purchaser_count: Number of distinct insiders who purchased.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.sale_value: Value of shares sold in USD.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.seller_count: Number of distinct insiders who sold.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.tickers: Ticker symbols of the issuer as of the transaction date. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes; the totals cover the issuer, not each ticker.
/stocks/insiders/vX/activity.transaction_date: Date of the transactions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.filing_count: Number of Form 3, 4, and 5 filings by the owner for this issuer.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.first_filing_date: Date of the owner's first Form 3, 4, or 5 filing for this issuer (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Filings begin in 2003.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.issuer_cik: SEC Central Index Key of the issuer company (10 digits, zero-padded).
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.issuer_name: Name of the issuer company as reported in the most recent filing.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.last_filing_date: Date of the owner's most recent Form 3, 4, or 5 filing for this issuer (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.officer_title: Title of the officer in the most recent filing, if the reporting owner is an officer.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.oldest_position_date: Earliest as_of_date among the summed positions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). A date far behind last_filing_date means at least one position has not been restated recently and may be stale.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.owner_cik: SEC Central Index Key of the reporting owner (10 digits, zero-padded). Stable across issuers and years; use it to follow a person through the Form 3, 4, and 5 endpoints.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.owner_name: Name of the reporting owner (individual or entity) as reported in the most recent filing.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.ownership_pct: shares_owned as a percentage of the issuer's shares outstanding (largest share class) as of last_filing_date. Absent when shares outstanding is not available for the issuer.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.position_count: Number of positions summed into shares_owned: one for direct holdings plus one per indirect vehicle.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.roles: Relationships of the reporting owner to the issuer in the most recent filing. Possible values: director, officer, ten_percent_owner, other.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.shares_owned: Shares of the issuer's non-derivative securities the owner holds: the sum of the latest reported balance of each position (direct, and each indirect vehicle) across their Form 3, 4, and 5 filings. As filed, not adjusted for splits. Unexercised options and other derivative securities are not included. Absent when the owner has never reported a share balance.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.shares_owned_direct: Shares held directly, in the owner's own name.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.shares_owned_indirect: Shares held indirectly through trusts, LLCs, family members, and other vehicles.
/stocks/insiders/vX/holdings.tickers: Ticker symbols of the issuer as of the owner's most recent filing. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes.

/stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures.description: Detailed explanation of what the disclosure category covers, including typical examples.
/stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures.taxonomy: Taxonomy version that defines this classification (e.g., '1.0').

/stocks/taxonomies/vX/risk-factors.description: Detailed explanation of what this risk category encompasses, including specific examples and potential impacts

/stocks/v1/dividends.cash_amount: Original dividend amount per share in the specified currency
/stocks/v1/dividends.currency: Currency code for the dividend payment (e.g., USD, CAD)
/stocks/v1/dividends.declaration_date: Date when the company officially announced the dividend
/stocks/v1/dividends.distribution_type: Classification describing the nature of this dividend's recurrence pattern: recurring (paid on a regular schedule), special (one-time or commemorative), supplemental (extra beyond the regular schedule), irregular (unpredictable or non-recurring), unknown (cannot be classified from available data)
/stocks/v1/dividends.ex_dividend_date: Date when the stock begins trading without the dividend value
/stocks/v1/dividends.frequency: How many times per year this dividend is expected to occur. A value of 0 means the distribution is non-recurring or irregular (e.g., special, supplemental, or a one-off dividend). Other possible values include 1 (annual), 2 (semi-annual), 3 (trimester), 4 (quarterly), 12 (monthly), 24 (bi-monthly), 52 (weekly), 104 (bi-weekly), and 365 (daily) depending on the issuer's declared or inferred payout cadence.
/stocks/v1/dividends.historical_adjustment_factor: Cumulative adjustment factor used to offset dividend effects on historical prices. To adjust a historical price for dividends: for a price on date D, find the first dividend whose `ex_dividend_date` is after date D and multiply the price by that dividend's `historical_adjustment_factor`.
/stocks/v1/dividends.id: Unique identifier for each dividend record
/stocks/v1/dividends.pay_date: Date when the dividend payment is distributed to shareholders
/stocks/v1/dividends.record_date: Date when shareholders must be on record to be eligible for the dividend payment
/stocks/v1/dividends.split_adjusted_cash_amount: Dividend amount adjusted for stock splits that occurred after the dividend was paid, expressed on a current share basis
/stocks/v1/dividends.ticker: Stock symbol for the company issuing the dividend

/stocks/v1/short-interest.avg_daily_volume: The average daily trading volume for the stock over a specified period, typically used to contextualize short interest.
/stocks/v1/short-interest.days_to_cover: Calculated as short_interest divided by avg_daily_volume, representing the estimated number of days it would take to cover all short positions based on average trading volume.
/stocks/v1/short-interest.settlement_date: The date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) on which the short interest data is considered settled, typically based on exchange reporting schedules.
/stocks/v1/short-interest.short_interest: The total number of shares that have been sold short but have not yet been covered or closed out.
/stocks/v1/short-interest.ticker: The primary ticker symbol for the stock.

/stocks/v1/short-volume.adf_short_volume: Short volume reported via the Alternative Display Facility (ADF), excluding exempt volume.
/stocks/v1/short-volume.adf_short_volume_exempt: Short volume reported via ADF that was marked as exempt.
/stocks/v1/short-volume.date: The date of trade activity reported in the format YYYY-MM-DD
/stocks/v1/short-volume.exempt_volume: Portion of short volume that was marked as exempt from regulation SHO.
/stocks/v1/short-volume.nasdaq_carteret_short_volume: Short volume reported from Nasdaq's Carteret facility, excluding exempt volume.
/stocks/v1/short-volume.nasdaq_carteret_short_volume_exempt: Short volume from Nasdaq Carteret that was marked as exempt.
/stocks/v1/short-volume.nasdaq_chicago_short_volume: Short volume reported from Nasdaq's Chicago facility, excluding exempt volume.
/stocks/v1/short-volume.nasdaq_chicago_short_volume_exempt: Short volume from Nasdaq Chicago that was marked as exempt.

/stocks/v1/short-volume.nyse_short_volume: Short volume reported from NYSE facilities, excluding exempt volume.

/v3/quotes/{fxTicker}.participant_timestamp: The nanosecond Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the quote was generated at the exchange.

/v3/quotes/{optionsTicker}.bid_size: The bid size. This represents the number of contracts buyers are bidding for at the given bid price.
/v3/quotes/{optionsTicker}.ask_size: The ask size. This represents the number of contracts sellers are offering at the given ask price.
/v3/quotes/{optionsTicker}.sequence_number: The sequence number represents the sequence in which quote events happened. These are increasing and unique per ticker symbol, but will not always be sequential (e.g., 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11).
/v3/quotes/{optionsTicker}.sip_timestamp: The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this quote from the exchange which produced it.

/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.bid_size: The bid size. This represents the number of shares buyers are bidding for at the given bid price.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.ask_size: The ask size. This represents the number of shares sellers are offering at the given ask price.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.conditions: A list of condition codes. See Stocks Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.indicators: A list of indicator codes. See the Conditions and Indicators (https://massive.com/glossary/conditions-indicators) glossary for what each code means.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.participant_timestamp: The nanosecond accuracy Participant/Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the quote was actually generated at the exchange.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.sequence_number: The sequence number represents the sequence in which quote events happened. These are increasing and unique per ticker symbol, but will not always be sequential (e.g., 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11). Values reset after each trading session/day.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.sip_timestamp: The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this quote from the exchange which produced it.
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.tape: There are 3 tapes which define which exchange the ticker is listed on. These are integers in our objects which represent the letter of the alphabet. Eg: 1 = A, 2 = B, 3 = C. * Tape A is NYSE listed securities * Tape B is NYSE ARCA / NYSE American * Tape C is NASDAQ
/v3/quotes/{stockTicker}.trf_timestamp: The nanosecond accuracy TRF (Trade Reporting Facility) Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade reporting facility received this quote.

/v3/snapshot.session.price: The price of the most recent trade or bid price for this asset. From the `session` object: Comprehensive trading session metrics, detailing price changes, trading volume, and key price points (open, close, high, low) for the asset within the current trading day. Includes specific changes during early, regular, and late trading periods to enable detailed performance analysis and trend tracking. Values describe the current trading session only; nothing carries over from the previous session apart from `previous_close`. For stocks snapshots, an asset that has not traded yet this session reports `volume: 0` with the price and change fields omitted rather than reported as 0. During early trading on stocks snapshots, `volume` and `price` track the session as it happens, but `open`, `high`, `low`, `close` and `vwap` are omitted until the regular session opens, as those report official session prices. They appear from the open and remain through late trading. For options snapshots, the early, regular and late trading changes use these sessions: early trading from 7:30 to 9:30 AM ET, the regular session from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM ET (4:15 PM ET for some products, such as SPY and SPX options), and late trading from the end of the regular session to 5:00 PM ET. Only trades marked with the extended hours condition (EXHT, 248) count as early or late trading. Cboe's extended trading hours program covers selected equity options, so other contracts do not get an early or late trading change. Index options, such as SPX, SPXW and XSP, get the regular trading change only. A change field is omitted when the contract has no trade in that session on the current trading day, or when the price it is measured against is missing. A change of 0 is returned as 0.

Includes specific changes during early, regular, and late trading periods to enable detailed performance analysis and trend tracking. Values describe the current trading session only; nothing carries over from the previous session apart from `previous_close`. For stocks snapshots, an asset that has not traded yet this session reports `volume: 0` with the price and change fields omitted rather than reported as 0. During early trading on stocks snapshots, `volume` and `price` track the session as it happens, but `open`, `high`, `low`, `close` and `vwap` are omitted until the regular session opens, as those report official session prices. They appear from the open and remain through late trading. For options snapshots, the early, regular and late trading changes use these sessions: early trading from 7:30 to 9:30 AM ET, the regular session from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM ET (4:15 PM ET for some products, such as SPY and SPX options), and late trading from the end of the regular session to 5:00 PM ET. Only trades marked with the extended hours condition (EXHT, 248) count as early or late trading. Cboe's extended trading hours program covers selected equity options, so other contracts do not get an early or late trading change. Index options, such as SPX, SPXW and XSP, get the regular trading change only. A change field is omitted when the contract has no trade in that session on the current trading day, or when the price it is measured against is missing. A change of 0 is returned as 0.
